subject: Request: Vaulted audit trace preservation exception for Solis Health
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@solishealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@solishealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Preservation exception request — vaulted audit traces for active case 8421

Hi Irene,

Quick ask from our InfoSec/Forensics team — for an active compliance investigation (case 8421) Solis needs a short-term preservation of a subset of audit traces beyond the platform default TTL. Specifically:

- Retain indexed request/response traces and associated correlation ids for tenant solis-prod for an additional 60 days beyond the standard 90-day TTL.
- Provide a deterministic manifest of the retained trace IDs and a sample export (CSV) that our forensics vendor can ingest.

We understand this is an exception to your default disposition workflows and are prepared to sign an attestation and cover incremental costs. Can you confirm feasibility, what evidence you can provide (SIG/CAIQ items), and the lead time?

Thanks,
Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Senior Security Program Manager | Solis Health
From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@solishealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preservation exception request — vaulted audit traces for active case 8421

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can evaluate a scoped preservation window for tenant-level audit traces. A couple quick clarifying questions before I loop in Product Security and Ops:

1) Which specific log classes do you need preserved (API request trace, KV cache events, system-level agent logs)?
2) Is the sample export required to include full request/response payloads or only correlation ids + timestamps + metadata?
3) Do you have a preferred SLA for the manifest delivery?

We typically handle these as time-bounded exceptions with: (a) an evidence manifest, (b) an approval attestation from the customer, and (c) a short audit report showing chain-of-custody controls. If you can confirm answers above I will put together a proposed preservation scope and cost estimate today.

Best,
Irene Choi
Customer Security Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@solishealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preservation exception request — vaulted audit traces for active case 8421

Hi Irene —

Answers:
- Keep: API request traces + authentication events + correlation ids. No system agent logs.
- Export: correlation ids + timestamps + headers (no PII payloads); vendor can reference payloads via correlation id if preserved.
- Manifest SLA: 48 hours preferred; if not possible, 72 hours acceptable.

We will sign an attestation. Please include any interim controls you will apply (encryption, access-restriction, read-only staging).

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alicia
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Preservation exception request — scoped retention for solis-prod

Irene / Grace —

We can support a 60-day extension on the specified log classes for tenant solis-prod as a scoped, time-bound exception. Proposed controls:

- Place the preserved bundle in an encrypted, access-restricted 'vault' (read-only) for 60 days. Access requires two-person approval and is logged to an immutable audit stream.
- Generate manifest (log_sample_manifest.csv) with correlation ids, timestamps, event type, and non-sensitive headers.
- Delivery timeline: manifest + 10k-sample export within 48 hours of approval; full manifest within 72 hours.
- Cost: one-time preservation fee + incremental storage, estimate attached.

We will need an attestation signed by Solis (we can provide a DocuSign template) and confirmation that Solis will not request further retention beyond the 60-day window. Once signed we will schedule Ops to snapshot and vault the traces.

Attaching: sig_evidence_matrix.xlsx (shows which SIG/CAIQ items are addressed by this exception).

Rishi
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference

Attachments: sig_evidence_matrix.xlsx
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@solishealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: security@solishealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700

- Please confirm the two-person approval identities (we need names for our audit).
- Can you redact headers that might contain internal tenant identifiers we don't control?

We will countersign the DocuSign as soon as you send it. Also appreciate if you can provide the sample CSV before the DocuSign is complete for our triage team to start ingesting.

Alicia

Thanks — Kimberly Park and Rishi Malhotra will be the two approvers for access requests to the preserved vault (names to appear in your audit). We will:
